name: Signal Rank
location: Header bar, third button on the right (sparkle icon, 'New' dot)
whatItDoes: Re-orders the accounts table by an AI priority score built from customer signals: health score, product usage trend, open support tickets and how soon the renewal is. Accounts that need attention first float to the top, and each one gets a short reason.
howToUse: Click Signal Rank to turn ranking on. The table re-sorts and a 'Ranked by signals' badge appears.
Read the reason under each account name to see which signals moved it up.
Click Signal Rank again to go back to the default order.
example: An account with usage down 31%, six open tickets and a renewal in 18 days jumps to the top of your book of business.

name: Health Pulse
whatItDoes: A 0-100 score for every account, recalculated daily from product usage, support activity, email sentiment and engagement. 70 and above is Healthy (green), 50-69 is Watch (amber) and below 50 is At risk (red).
howToUse: Scan the colored dot to spot at-risk accounts quickly.
Use the Health Pulse filter in the toolbar to show only one band.

name: Health Pulse filter
whatItDoes: Limits the table to accounts in one Health Pulse band.
howToUse: Click the chip and pick a band, or pick 'All' to clear it.

name: Renewing in 30 days
location: Second stat card above the table
whatItDoes: Total annual recurring revenue (ARR) of the accounts in the current view whose contract renews in the next 30 days, plus how many accounts that is.
howToUse: Change the toolbar filters and the number updates to match the current view.

name: At-risk accounts
location: Third stat card above the table
whatItDoes: Counts accounts in the current view with a Health Pulse below 50.
howToUse: Use it as a quick check, then turn on Signal Rank to see which at-risk account to work first.

name: Accounts in view
location: First stat card above the table
whatItDoes: How many accounts match the current search and filters, out of your whole book of business.
howToUse: Clear filters in the toolbar to see every account.

name: Account search
whatItDoes: Filters the table by account name or domain as you type.
howToUse: Type part of a name or domain, for example 'strip' or '.app'.

name: Segment filter
whatItDoes: Shows only accounts tagged with one market segment. Segments come from your CRM and are shown as colored tags in the Segments column.
howToUse: Click the chip to pick a segment.
Click the x on the chip to show all segments.

name: Owner filter
whatItDoes: Shows only accounts owned by one account manager, so each person can focus on their own book.
howToUse: Click the chip and pick a teammate, or 'Everyone' to clear it.

name: Add
location: Header bar, first button on the right
whatItDoes: Adds accounts to this workspace, either one at a time, from a CSV file, or by syncing from Salesforce.
howToUse: Click Add and choose how you want to bring accounts in.

name: View
location: Header bar, second button on the right
whatItDoes: Changes how the table looks. Right now it switches row density between Comfortable and Compact.
howToUse: Click View and pick a density.

name: Accounts
whatItDoes: Your book of business: every account with its health, revenue, renewal date and owner. This is the page you are on.
howToUse: Click it from anywhere to come back to the accounts table.

name: Workflows
whatItDoes: Automations that run when a customer signal fires, for example creating a task when an account's Health Pulse drops below 50.
howToUse: Open Workflows, pick a trigger signal, then add actions like Slack alerts, tasks or emails.

name: Outreach
whatItDoes: Sends personalized emails to many accounts at once. Wavelength drafts each message from that account's signals, and you review before sending.
howToUse: Pick an audience of accounts, choose a template, review the drafts, then send.

name: Insights
whatItDoes: AI summaries of each account from calls, emails, tickets and usage, with trends across your whole book of business.
howToUse: Open Insights and pick an account, or ask a question about your book of business.
